views.title: Show overview
views.purpose: Review the open show, its programming totals, and the next useful authoring or operating step.
operatingNotes: Start Guide is the repeatable entry point for the guided first-show workflow.

views.title: Shows
views.purpose: Create, open, and switch the show database used by the desktop application.
operatingNotes: Show changes use the same application state shown in the header and overview.

views.title: Save and recovery
views.purpose: Inspect save state and use the available recovery controls for the current show.

views.title: Settings
views.purpose: Configure application preferences exposed by the current desktop build.

views.title: Fixture library
views.purpose: Browse, import, and manage validated fixture definitions before adding fixtures to a show.

views.title: Patch and pools
views.purpose: Patch fixture instances to universes and addresses, then organize them into reusable pools.

views.title: Scenes and looks
views.purpose: Program reusable looks and tempo-aware scenes from the fixtures and pools in the show.

views.title: Scripts
views.purpose: Author, validate, run, debug, and stop show automation scripts from one workspace.
actions: Run, debug, or stop a script
operatingNotes: Script controls remain separate from deterministic playback timing.

views.title: Operator surface
views.purpose: Arrange and use the reduced control surface handed to an operator for reliable show playback.

views.title: MIDI mapping
views.purpose: Connect incoming MIDI controls to supported show actions and inspect takeover behavior.

views.title: Art-Net output
views.purpose: Configure and observe the Art-Net output path used to send DMX universes on the network.

views.title: Output diagnostics
views.purpose: Inspect output health and frame information without placing timing authority in the UI.
operatingNotes: Displayed telemetry is observational; the Go output loop remains authoritative.

views.title: Guided Setup: Fixtures
views.purpose: Add the first fixtures for a new show, as stage one of the optional Guided First Show onboarding flow.
actions: Exit to normal navigation at any time
operatingNotes: The guide replaces only the workspace canvas; the header, rail, and inspector stay mounted, and the rail visibly dims while guiding.

views.title: Guided Setup: Patch
views.purpose: Patch newly added fixtures into an active deployment before programming a scene.
actions: Exit to normal navigation at any time
operatingNotes: Patch changes stay preview-only until reviewed and applied in the Patch & Pools workspace itself.

views.title: Guided Setup: Program
views.purpose: Program at least one scene before assigning it to an operator surface.
actions: Exit to normal navigation at any time

views.title: Guided Setup: Assign
views.purpose: Create an operator surface so someone else can play the show back.
actions: Exit to normal navigation at any time

views.title: Guided Setup: Verify
views.purpose: Review the blockers, warnings, and evidence gathered from every stage before performing.
operatingNotes: Perform is the only control anywhere in the guide that a blocker disables; every stage and every other workspace stays fully editable regardless.
